description: This PHP source file provides an example usage of the Kint debugging library, defining classes for user management and demonstrating variable debugging and tracing features within an HTML page context.

classes.name: BaseUser
classes.description: A base class representing a user with a method for retrieving the full name.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A user class extending BaseUser, containing user attributes, constants for roles and paths, and methods for setting data, comparing users, and managing creation date.

classes.name: UserManager
classes.description: A class managing a User instance, with methods for retrieving, debugging, and ensuring the user.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the user (method stub).

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if the current user is equal to another user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username of the user.

methods.name: setAdditionalData
methods.description: Sets additional data associated with the user.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date as a DateTime object.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Triggers a trace for debugging purposes.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the current user managed by UserManager.

methods.name: debugUser
methods.description: Sets the user to debug and outputs its data.

methods.name: ensureUser
methods.description: Calls ensure() on the current user to generate a trace.
